messages:
maria: Hey team — PR #7421 is failing CI on windows-e2e. Tests pass locally for me but CI shows a timeout in test_upload_timeout. Can someone take a quick look? I'm OOO after 4pm but want to get this unblocked before tomorrow's cut. :clock4:

ci-bot: GitHub Actions: windows-e2e (workflow: e2e-windows) failed for PR #7421 — job `windows-2022-e2e` — run 12. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/98765

maria: Relevant snippet from the CI log:
```
E   TimeoutError: Upload did not complete within 120s
  File "tests/integration/test_upload.py", line 87, in test_upload_timeout
    assert uploader.complete()
```

jamal: @maria thanks for the ping. Looks like the same flake we saw last month. Usually a job rerun fixes it. Can you try a rerun? I can dig in if it repros locally. :eyes:

maria: I kicked a rerun (`/retest`) a minute ago. Waiting on results. If it fails again I'll attach a full trace.

lily: FYI this might be related to long path handling on windows agents — see https://go/internal/issues/issue-2043. We added a workaround in tests for PRs touching the uploader. PR #7018 had a similar failure.

jamal: If it comes back failing, quick mitigation is to increase the upload timeout to 180s in the test harness, but that's more of a bandaid. I'd rather see if the agent is saturated. @ivo can you check if the windows runners had high CPU during the run?

ivo: Checking runner metrics now. There was a spike on runner-windows-02 around 2025-11-06T13:02Z — concurrent builds jumped. Possible noisy neighbor.

ci-bot: Rerun complete — windows-e2e (run 13) passed ✅

maria: Great, green now. Thanks @jamal @ivo for the quick checks. I'll open an internal ticket to track the windows runner saturation and add a non-flaky test guard for uploader.

anita: If you want, I can do a quick follow-up PR that adds a retry wrapper around the upload call in tests — small and easy to revert. :thumbsup:

maria: That'd be awesome @anita — thanks. For now I'm going to merge PR #7421 since CI is green and it's a low-risk change. Will follow up on the infra ticket tomorrow.

sean-m: Thanks for the fast turnaround. Merging after green is fine. Please add a note in the PR description about the transient flake.

maria: Will do. Closing thread.
